paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Financial Analyst - FP&A role in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) student at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. What interests me about Newsweek is that the role owns the topline: traffic, impressions, revenue, bookings and subscribers, all tied back to the plan.

At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and created dashboards that brought predictive metrics and financial projections together for decision makers. At JPMorgan I built models to evaluate $10M in marketing-channel budget allocation across scenarios, which gave me a feel for how audience and channel metrics turn into revenue.

That fits the monthly forecast and reporting cycle, the annual plan and the executive materials this role produces. At Thomson Reuters I also supported monthly P&L forecasting and close, so I know the rhythm of a reporting calendar. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
